race.comment: READY FOR THIS (3) placed last time (19.74) at this track in a Grade 4/5, finishing second and beaten 1.75 lengths. Rates a leading player. RAIN ABOUT (7) recorded two placings in a row before an overdue win last time, scoring by 3 lengths (19.88) at this track. Shapes as a top winning chance on latest effort. DEPUTY (2) has a strong overall record having five wins and 10 places from 20 starts but was out of the money last time when seventh (20.54) over 366m at this track. Performs well off this draw. Best form too dangerous to ignore. Have to include. KACHINA RIPPLE (8) cannot be underestimated.
